### `cloud eval validate`

Validate a local eval **suite file**: the versioned dec
larative document that\ndescribes a suite, its defaults and its cases (`schemaVersion: \"1\"`, YAML\ncanonical, JSON accepted, con

ventionally `.mcpjam/evals/*.yaml`).

Offline by default: without `--project` this command builds no API client, reads
no API k
ey and never touches the network. Passing `--project` is the only thing\nthat changes that, and it is keyed off the FLAG; a linked

directory or an
`MCPJAM_PROJECT` in the environment never turns the offline command into a
networked one.

| Flag | Required

| Description |
| - | - | - |
| `--file <path>` | Yes | Suite file to validate, `.yaml` or `.json` (or `-` for stdin) |
| `--pr
oject <id-or-name>` | No | Also resolve the file's deterministic tool references against this project's live servers. Opt-in; auth

enticates and makes network calls |

| Exit code | Meaning |
| - | - |
| `0` | Valid |
| `1` | Parsed, but invalid against th
e suite-file contract. Every finding is reported, not just the first. `eval run --file` on the same bytes exits **2**: 1 is reserv

ed there for a real verdict |
| `2` | Nothing was validated: unreadable path, input over the 1 MiB limit, or malformed YAML |

Input is capped at **1,048,576 bytes (1 MiB) of UTF-8** and is never truncated:
a file over the cap is rejected outright.

Unde
ile\": \".mcpjam/evals/s_billing.yaml\",\n \"stage\": \"contract\", // \"contract\" is exit 1; \"input\" and \"parse\"

are exit 2
 "findings": [
 {
 "code": "SUITE_FILE_INVALID", // or SUITE_FILE_TOO_LARGE / _EMPTY / _YAML_INVALI
D / _MULTIPLE_DOCUMENTS\n \"path\": [\"cases\", 1, \"id\"], // field path as segments\n \"pointer\": \"cases[1].id\
", // the same path, rendered\n \"message\": \"duplicate case id \\\"c_refund\\\"\"\n // `location` accompanies S
UITE_FILE_YAML_INVALID findings only, where the\n // YAML parser reported a position: { \"line\": 24, \"column\": 9 }\n }\

n ]
}
```

Findings are deterministically ordered and carry no timestamps, so two runs over
the same bytes produce byte-iden

tical output.

An unreadable or missing path is a usage error and goes to stderr in the CLI's
standard error envelope rather th

an as findings; nothing was read, so there is
nothing to report about.

**What "valid" does not mean, without `--project`.**
The offline check judges\nthe file against the suite-file contract. It does **not** re-resolve tool names,\nserver references or f

ixtures against a project's live discovery, so a file that
validates here can still fail to run.

# Create an eval case

> Adds one case to the suite. Both `title` and a non-empty `steps` array are require
d: `steps` is optional on the shared case shape so PATCH can be partial, but a case persisted without executable steps could never

run. When `models` is omitted the suite's configured model is used.
